name: What is the typical process for interior wall painting?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for interior wall painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our interior wall painting process begins with a detailed consultation to understand your vision and assess the space. We then prepare the area by moving furniture, protecting floors, and patching any holes or cracks. Next, we apply primer if necessary, followed by two coats of high-quality paint for a durable, even finish. After painting, we conduct a thorough cleanup and a final walkthrough with you to ensure your complete satisfaction. We strive to minimize disruption and deliver exceptional results efficiently.
acceptedAnswer.description: The typical process involves consultation, room preparation, patching, priming, painting, cleanup, and a final walkthrough to ensure satisfaction.
